summary: CipherChat end-to-end testing complete. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases PASS covering auth (register, login success/failure, lockout 429 after 10 fails, /me 401), user search, chat creation + direct-dedup + group validation, non-member 404, message send/receive, 409 on key-set mismatch, Mongo blind-relay invariant (no plaintext fields in docs), disappearing TTL. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): auth register+login UI works, two-browser E2E flow verified — User A registers, creates direct chat with User B, sends encrypted message; User B's chat list auto-populates via 3s polling, preview shows decrypted text, opening the chat shows the decrypted bubble with green verified shield within ~5s. Session persists across reload. Settings tab renders profile, 32-hex fingerprint, copy-to-clipboard toast works. Wrong-password error path not reached due to logout double-tap not consistently firing on web (minor UX, likely rapid 2nd Pressable tap debounce).

ui_bugs.issue: Double-tap confirm→destroy flow: two rapid Playwright clicks (600ms apart) left the button in uncommitted 'DESTROY SESSION' label state and did not log out. Likely needs a slightly longer confirm window or an explicit confirm-visible transition before accepting the second tap. Users with slower tap cadence will succeed; worth verifying on real device.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate logout-button double-tap on web: either widen the confirm window or expose a distinct confirm-state testID so tests/users can target it reliably.
No functional bugs blocking release; crypto/polling/zero-knowledge flows all verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:256 — hasher.verify always runs (even for missing user) via DUMMY_HASH: good constant-time behavior.
server.py:341 — strict equality on keys set vs member_ids correctly returns 409 on mismatch (tested).
crypto.ts caches decryption results by msg id in a module-level Map; fine for session but will grow unbounded on long sessions — consider LRU cap.

auth.tsx stores session (including identity private keys) via secureSet which on web falls back to AsyncStorage (IndexedDB). Acceptable per code comment but worth flagging to users that web is not as secure as native keychain.
seed_data_creation: Each test run registers fresh TEST_-prefixed users (alpha_*, bravo_*, gamma_*) via /api/auth/register. No shared seed data; MongoDB TTL index on login_failures.at auto-cleans lockout records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_cipherchat_backend.py (pytest, 22 cases, ~8s). Run: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v --asyncio-mode=auto`. All frontend testIDs confirmed: auth-mode-register/login, auth-username-input, auth-display-name-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-button, auth-error, new-chat-button, user-search-input, user-result-<username>, message-input, send-message-button, message-bubble-<id>, chat-row-<id>, chat-header-info, disappear-timer-button, timer-option-<sec>, tab-settings, my-fingerprint, copy-fingerprint-button, toast, logout-button. Chat tiles use testID 'chat-row-<id>' NOT 'chat-tile-'. To fill TextInput on RNW use `page.click + keyboard.type` (not page.fill) so onChangeText fires. KDF (3000 iters) takes ~2–4s on register/login — wait 5s after submit.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking issues. The only observed anomaly (logout double-tap) could not be definitively reproduced as a bug; needs manual confirmation on device.
